title: String builder
description:
Write a class `TextBuilder` that assembles text piece by piece with chained calls:

```cpp
TextBuilder b{};
b.add("Total").add(": ").repeat('*', 3).line().add("done");
b.text();      // "Total: ***\ndone"
```

| Member | Does |
|---|---|
| `TextBuilder& add(std::string_view piece)` | appends the piece |
| `TextBuilder& repeat(char c, int times)` | appends `c` that many times (nothing if `times` is below 1) |
| `TextBuilder& line()` | appends a newline character |
| `TextBuilder& clear()` | empties the text |
| `const std::string& text() const` | the text so far, returned by const reference (no copy) |
| `std::size_t length() const` | its length |
lessonTitle: this, const Member Functions and Chaining
